# Known-broken <tests> tags that .github/scripts/Test-TestsTagLink.ps1 tolerates.
#
# Format: source | tag | reason
#   source  the repository-relative file that holds the tag
#   tag     the tag's text, trimmed, exactly as written
#   reason  why it is broken and why it was not fixed mechanically
#
# Each entry here is a link nobody could repair with confidence: the test it named is gone, or more
# than one test could have replaced it. Fix the tag and delete its entry; the guard fails on an entry
# whose tag resolves or no longer exists, so this list only shrinks. Never add a new break here to get
# a change through: point the tag at the test that covers the member instead.
